title: Markov Chains
description: A process with no memory: where it goes next depends only on where it is. Run it long enough and it settles into a fixed share of time in each state.

puzzle.goal: A machine breaks with chance a on any day and is mended with chance b. Write the fraction P of days it works in the long run.
puzzle.name: Stationary share
puzzle.ask: Find P for a = @{a} and b = @{b}.
puzzle.method: Settled, as many machines break each day as are mended: P·a = (1 − P)·b.
